human-design.item.type.0.career: As a Projector, you're designed to guide, not to grind. You see how people and systems work and how they could work better, which makes you a natural adviser, manager or specialist. You don't have consistent, self-renewing work energy (an open Sacral centre), so long hours of doing burn you out in a way they don't burn out others. Your success comes from being recognised for your insight and using your energy well, not from outworking everyone.

human-design.item.type.1.career: Your strategy is to wait for the invitation, especially for the big things like a new job, a major role or a client. Your best opportunities come when someone recognises what you see and asks for it. This isn't passivity: it means making your expertise visible, then letting the right people come to you. Pushing your ideas on people who haven't asked tends to meet resistance and leave you bitter. Being invited tends to bring respect and good terms.

human-design.item.type.2.career: Your authority is emotional: clarity comes over time, as your feelings rise and fall, not in the moment. For career decisions, this is the most important rule in your chart: don't say yes or no on the spot, however exciting or urgent it feels. Sleep on it, ride the wave for days or weeks, and decide when you feel calm and clear. Big moves made at an emotional high or low are the ones you're most likely to regret.

human-design.item.type.3.career: Your 2/4 profile is the Hermit and the Opportunist. The Hermit line has natural talents that others notice before you do, and needs time alone to work. The Opportunist line finds its opportunities through its network: friends, former colleagues, people who already know and trust you. Your next role or client is much more likely to come through someone you know than through a cold application. Look after your relationships, and let people call you out.

human-design.item.type.4.career: Split definition: you think and decide better with the right people around. A trusted sounding board connects the dots for you.

human-design.item.type.5.career: Your Incarnation Cross carries the themes of its four gates: Details (62) and Mystery (61) from your birth, and Growth (42) and Continuity (32) from your design. As a life theme, it describes someone who makes sense of complex things, explains them precisely, finishes cycles well and preserves what's worth keeping. It's the purpose of an expert who helps others understand, and who works best when the work grows over time rather than in sudden bursts.

human-design.item.centres.0.career: An open Head: you take on other people's questions and pressures. Choose which problems are actually yours to solve.

human-design.item.centres.1.career: An open Ajna: you can see many points of view, which makes you a fair adviser. Don't feel you must be certain to be credible.

human-design.item.centres.2.career: Your Throat centre is defined, with gates 62 (Details), 12 (Caution) and 31 (Influence). Your voice is consistent and reliable: you can articulate, explain and speak with authority. Gate 31 makes your voice one of influence and leadership; gate 62 gives precision with facts; gate 12 adds care about when and how to speak. This is a strong asset for advisory and communication work. Speak when you're recognised or asked, and your words carry real weight.

human-design.item.centres.3.career: Your G centre, identity and direction, is defined with gates 7, 1, 13 and 2. You have a steady sense of who you are and where you're heading, even when circumstances change. Gate 7 is the role of the self in leading; gate 1 is self-expression; gate 13 is the listener; gate 2 is direction. You're designed to know your direction. Trust it, especially when others want to steer you.

human-design.item.centres.4.career: Your Heart (Ego) centre is open: willpower and self-worth aren't fixed for you, so you can feel you have to prove yourself or promise more than you can deliver. In work and money this matters: you may undercharge, over-promise or take on commitments to show your value. Your value doesn't depend on proving it. Make fewer promises, price your work by what it's worth to others, and let someone else push for you sometimes.

human-design.item.centres.5.career: Your Sacral centre, the source of sustainable work energy, is open. You don't have a consistent, renewable battery for long hours, even though you can borrow energy from others and feel productive for a while. This is the most important practical fact in your chart for burnout: work less in hours, more in impact. A role or business model that relies on you pushing hard every day will wear you out.

human-design.item.centres.6.career: A defined Solar Plexus: your emotions are consistent and strong. Your mood affects your judgement, so give decisions time.

human-design.item.centres.7.career: An open Spleen: you may stay in jobs or situations that aren't good for you because leaving feels risky. Check whether caution is fear.

human-design.item.centres.8.career: A defined Root: you have steady drive and handle pressure well. Deadlines can motivate you, but you set the pace.

human-design.item.channels.0.career: The Channel of The Alpha (7–31) connects your G centre to your Throat. It's the design of a leader: someone whose direction and influence others follow, when they recognise it. For a Projector, this is leadership by recognition, not by force. You're designed to be invited into roles of influence and to guide groups well. Whether that's leading in an organisation or advising leaders, your voice is meant to be heard on the direction of things.

human-design.item.channels.1.career: Channel of Recognition (30–41): strong desire for new experiences and feelings. It gives drive, but also impatience; wait for the emotional clarity before acting.

human-design.item.gates.0.career: Your Personality Sun is in gate 62, Details, line 2. Your core theme is precision: finding the facts, naming things clearly and explaining complex matters so they can be understood. This is a natural gift for policy, analysis, editing and advice. Line 2 (the Hermit) means the gift is natural and often noticed by others first. Your expertise is your calling card.

human-design.item.gates.1.career: Personality Earth in gate 61, Mystery: you're grounded by wanting to know why. Deep research and inner truth keep you steady.

human-design.item.gates.2.career: Personality North Node in 41.6: your future direction is to start new experiences, setting an example for others as you do.

human-design.item.gates.3.career: Personality South Node in 31.6: in the past, influence came through example. That still serves you as a quiet leader.

human-design.item.gates.4.career: Personality Moon in 51.5, Shock: you're driven by initiative and you handle crises well. Others look to you when things go wrong.

human-design.item.gates.5.career: Personality Mercury in 31.5, Influence: your thinking is aimed at leadership. People expect you to have the practical answer.

human-design.item.gates.6.career: Personality Venus in 12.2, Caution: you value careful, timely expression. Speak when the moment's right and your words land well.

human-design.item.gates.7.career: Personality Mars in 3.6, Ordering: you push to bring order to chaos, especially at the start of new things.

human-design.item.gates.8.career: Personality Jupiter in 62.2, Details: your good fortune comes through precision and expertise. Getting the facts right opens doors.

human-design.item.gates.9.career: Personality Saturn in 61.2, Mystery: discipline comes through study and inner truth. Mastery grows when you go deep.

human-design.item.gates.10.career: Personality Uranus in 58.4, Vitality: you bring originality to improving things. You enjoy making systems work better.

human-design.item.gates.11.career: Personality Neptune in 38.4, The Fighter: you're willing to struggle for what has meaning. Choose your fights by purpose.

human-design.item.gates.12.career: Personality Pluto in 1.2, Self-Expression: deep down you need to express yourself in your own way, in your own time.

human-design.item.gates.13.career: Your Design Sun is in gate 42, Growth, line 4. Below the surface, your theme is bringing things to completion: seeing a cycle through, growing steadily, and finishing what's been started. Line 4 (the Opportunist) ties this to your network: growth comes through people you know. In work, this is the steady hand who carries projects to their conclusion, and who does best when the work grows over time.

human-design.item.gates.14.career: Design Earth in 32.4, Continuity: you're grounded by preserving what works. Fear of failure can make you overly cautious.

human-design.item.gates.15.career: Design North Node in 13.1, The Listener: your future direction includes hearing people's stories and keeping confidences.

human-design.item.gates.16.career: Design South Node in 7.1, Role of the Self: you've led from behind before, and that's still comfortable.

human-design.item.gates.17.career: Design Moon in 5.3, Fixed Rhythms: you need regular routines, but you may sacrifice them for others. Protect your rhythm.

human-design.item.gates.18.career: Design Mercury in 2.1, Direction: you know your direction intuitively, before you can explain it.

human-design.item.gates.19.career: Design Venus in 37.4, Friendship: you value loyal working relationships and fair bargains. Good partnerships matter to you.

human-design.item.gates.20.career: Design Mars in 30.1, Recognition of Feelings: you're driven by strong desires. Let them settle before you act on them.

human-design.item.gates.21.career: Design Jupiter in 52.1, Stillness: your good fortune grows when you stay still and focused. Don't force the timing.

human-design.item.gates.22.career: Design Saturn in 61.5, Mystery: discipline comes from seeking practical truths that others can use.

human-design.item.gates.23.career: Design Uranus in 38.1, The Fighter: you're unusually stubborn about what matters to you. Use it to hold your ground.

human-design.item.gates.24.career: Design Neptune in 38.6, The Fighter: in time, you learn which struggles are worth it. Wisdom over battle.

human-design.item.gates.25.career: Design Pluto in 1.5, Self-Expression: deep down you need your creativity to be useful to others.

human-design.overview.type.overview: Your design is a Projector with emotional authority and a 2/4 profile. As a Projector, you see deeply into people and systems; your role is to guide, and your strategy is to wait to be recognised and invited, especially for the big things. Your emotional authority means your clarity comes over time, not in the moment: big decisions need you to ride your emotional wave and decide when you're calm. Your 2/4 profile combines the Hermit, with natural gifts that others see and call out, and the Opportunist, whose opportunities come through a warm network. Split definition means you often find clarity with the right people around you. Your Incarnation Cross brings together Details, Mystery, Growth and Continuity: understanding complex things precisely, and seeing them through.
human-design.overview.type.career: For work, this is the design of an expert adviser: someone with natural insight, a voice that carries, and a network that brings the right invitations. You're not built for endless hours; you're built for high-impact guidance. Wait for real recognition before big moves, make career decisions slowly, and let your network know what you do so the invitations can come.

human-design.overview.centres.overview: Four of your nine centres are defined: Throat, G, Solar Plexus and Root. Your voice, identity and direction are consistent; your emotions run in a strong, steady wave; and you have reliable drive under pressure. Five centres are open: Head, Ajna, Heart (Ego), Sacral and Spleen. In these you take in and amplify what's around you: other people's questions and certainties, their willpower and pressure to prove themselves, their work energy, and their fears. Open centres are where you learn the most about others, and where you can mistake their pressures for your own.
human-design.overview.centres.career: For work: your consistent voice and direction (Throat, G) make you a strong communicator and guide. Your open Sacral and Heart are the warning lights. You can't sustain long hours on your own energy, and you may try to prove your worth by overcommitting or undercharging. Design your work around impact and clear terms, not effort and willpower.

human-design.overview.channels.overview: You have two defined channels. The Channel of The Alpha (7–31) connects your G centre to your Throat: the design of leadership through recognised direction, a voice that influences where a group is going. The Channel of Recognition (30–41) connects your Solar Plexus to your Root: a strong drive for new experiences and the feelings they bring, fuelling desire and anticipation. One channel speaks and leads; the other feels and desires. Together they describe someone who leads with conviction and is moved by strong feelings about what could be.
human-design.overview.channels.career: For work, the Alpha channel is your clearest career signature: you're designed to influence direction, as a leader or as the adviser to leaders, when you're recognised for it. The Recognition channel gives you the hunger for something new. Let that hunger move you, but act only when the emotional wave has settled.

human-design.career.reading:
Your Human Design is the design of an expert guide: a Projector with a consistent voice, a clear sense of direction and the Channel of The Alpha, the channel of leadership through recognition. Your Personality Sun in gate 62 (Details) gives you precision with facts and a gift for explaining complex things; your Design Sun in gate 42 (Growth) gives you the steadiness to bring things to completion. These are classic advisory and leadership gifts: you see how things should work, say it clearly, and help others get there.

How you work best: by invitation. Your strategy is to wait to be recognised and invited, especially for big things like a new role or a client. Your 2/4 profile says those invitations most often come through your network: people who already know your work. Your decisions should be slow: with emotional authority, never say yes or no on the spot.

Where work gets hard: your Sacral centre is open, so you don't have renewable energy for long hours; you can borrow it from others and then crash. Your Heart (Ego) centre is open too, so you may feel you have to prove your worth, promise too much or undercharge. Together these are a recipe for burnout if your work is built on hours and willpower.

What the timing asks: transits are currently completing several of your channels, including Awareness (24–61) and Struggle (28–38), and temporarily defining your open centres. That can make you feel unusually energised, driven and certain. Treat that as borrowed. Notice the invitations that come, but make no big decisions until the feeling settles.

highlights.title: Channel of The Alpha
highlights.why: The 7–31 channel joins your direction to your voice: leadership through recognition. It's your clearest career signature. You're designed to influence where things go, as a leader or the trusted adviser to one, when people invite you to.

highlights.title: Sacral
highlights.why: Open, so you don't have renewable energy for long hours. For a career decision this matters a great deal: a role or business that depends on you grinding every day will burn you out. Build your work around impact, not hours.

highlights.title: Heart (Ego)
highlights.why: Open, so willpower and self-worth aren't fixed. In work, it shows up as over-promising, proving yourself and undercharging. Price by value, promise less, and let others advocate for you.

highlights.title: Inner Authority
highlights.why: Emotional: clarity comes over time, not in the moment. For any career move, this is the rule: sleep on it, ride the wave, and decide only when you feel calm and clear.

highlights.title: Profile
highlights.why: 2/4: natural gifts others notice, and opportunities that come through your network. Your next role or client is most likely to come through someone who already knows your work.

human-design.month.reading:
This month's transits keep touching your Throat and G centres, the core of your career signature. On 29 October, Saturn completes the channel of Acceptance (17–62) with your gate 62, bringing a serious, structured kind of thinking: a good few days for organising your ideas and the facts behind them. On 31 October, Earth completes Awareness (24–61) with your gate 61, and inspiration can come in a rush.

In early November the Sun moves through gates 1 (Self-Expression) and 43 (Insight), and on 11 November the sky defines Structuring (23–43), a collective push to explain new ideas clearly. Mercury completes Struggle (28–38) on 8 November: a few days where you may feel you must fight for what matters; choose carefully. Mercury and Venus turn direct on 14 November.

The strongest days for your work come on 17 November, when the Sun completes The Beat (2–14) with your gate 2 and Earth completes Inspiration (1–8) with your gate 1. Both run through your G centre of direction: a strong moment to show what you stand for, and to notice who recognises it. Remember your authority: let any decision ripen before you act.

The sky defines Structuring (23–43): good for explaining your idea simply.
The Sun and Earth complete channels through your G centre: show your direction.
